title: internal/core tests pin a machine-global /tmp/p project root — every concurrent lane writes the same dir, so any predicate gating on that suite samples shared mutable state
evidence: ~10 internal/core test files hardcode CycleRequest{ProjectRoot: "/tmp/p"} (apicover_misc_test.go:355, catalog_refresher_test.go:23, fleet_lock_test.go:20, observer_test.go:38, reviewer_test.go:41,...); /tmp/p/.evolve/runs currently holds 19521 entries. Matches the cycle-1107 and cycle-1116 ACS evidence excerpts verbatim: '[orchestrator] archived polluted workspace: /tmp/p/.evolve/runs/cycle-10 -> ...polluted-...' + 'fatal: not a git repository' + 'WARN worktree provisioning failed'. Independently diagnosed by cycle-1116's own retrospective (.evolve/runs/cycle-1116/retrospective-report.md:147-152) which named it cycle-1116-core-suite-shares-machine-global-tmp-p-project-root; the lesson YAML was never written (retro-cannot-write-lessons gap), so this item is the only durable carrier.
notes: This is the ACTUAL trigger for the cycle-1107 and cycle-1116 false FAILs — NOT auditor probes (those explain 1115 and 1117, whose predicates ran ./internal/bridge; 1107/1116 never did) and NOT CPU contention (three concurrent `go test ./internal/core/` runs pass on an idle host — the wrong flavour of contention was tested). The real mechanism is a shared FIXED PATH mutated by concurrent fleet lanes, which sibling go-test processes on an idle host cannot reproduce. FIX: replace the hardcoded "/tmp/p" with per-test t.TempDir() so each test owns its project root. Note acssuite.retryFlakyReds (acssuite.go:388-403) already re-runs a red scope once and cycle-1116 lost both rolls — a one-shot retry does not paper over a shared-state defect.
acceptance: No test under go/internal/core references a hardcoded "/tmp/p"; a grep guard keeps it that way.
RED first: two concurrent runs of the core suite against a PRE-POLLUTED shared root reproduce the 'archived polluted workspace' path; after the fix each run is isolated and green.
cd go && go test -race -count=1 ./internal/core/... N/N PASS.
